sql: select count(*) as "count" from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null)

select * from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) order by (SELECT status FROM crm_accounts WHERE id=leads.account_id) asc, "id" desc limit $1 offset $2
